messages:
max-sales: Heads up — CardioMetrics POC is seeing intermittent 429s during load tests. Demo in ~2h, they're nervous.
jen-support: Which endpoints and can you paste a raw 429 body? Also what concurrency are they running?
max-sales: Mostly /v1/completions, some /v1/embeddings. They run ~32 parallel workers from a local harness. Sample 429 (redacted):
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "code": "per_route_burst",
  "route": "/v1/completions",
  "retry_after": null,
  "request_id": "cm-5b7"
}
```
jen-support: Retry-After null is weird — sometimes we see missing or 0 in special cases. Could be a limiter edge where it returns 429 without header. We'll triage.
li-eng: Two likely causes: 1) per-route burst limit (short bursts from many concurrent short requests), 2) token burn-rate spike across routes. Important: embeddings and completions draw from the same tenant token pool but have separate per-route bursts. So you can hit per-route 429s while tenant monthly usage is low.
arin-oncall: Pulling live tenant counters now.
quota-bot: tenant snapshot: tenant=cardiometrics, month_commit=750000, month_used=34k (4.5%), inflight_token_estimate=11.2k, per_route_burst(/v1/completions)=700/min, per_route_rps=110
li-eng: Inflight token estimate + concurrency explains the bursts. For an immediate fix we can either: a) temporary per-route burst bump for the tenant for the demo window, or b) ask the client to cap concurrency and implement backoff with jitter. Fastest for the demo is a temporary bump.
max-sales: They want the demo solid. Apply a temporary bump and we'll tell them it's time-limited.
arin-oncall: Queuing per-route bump to 2000 for 3h. Need sales confirmation.
max-sales: Confirmed, apply it.
quota-bot: Quota change requested: tenant=cardiometrics, route=/v1/completions, burst=2000, duration=10800s, id=Q-187532-02
quota-bot: Change applied. Expires at 187532?10800
jen-support: After bump, also tell them to implement these client-side mitigations: set max_concurrency <= 10 for demos, reuse HTTP keep-alive connections, prefer streaming for responses >150 tokens, and implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After when present.
li-eng: Backoff pseudocode to share: `base=0.5s; attempt=0..n; if Retry-After present: sleep = Retry-After + random(0, 0.2*Retry-After); else: backoff = min(30s, base * 2**attempt); sleep = random_between(0, backoff)`.
max-sales: Also they asked if embeddings count separately — please confirm.
li-eng: Confirmed: embeddings hit /v1/embeddings and have their own per-route burst, but both routes consume the tenant token pool. If they run embeddings concurrently with completions, peak token burn can trigger token-burn 429s separate from per-route caps.
arin-oncall: Monitoring now; after the change we see no 429s in the last 8 minutes and token burn within temporary allowance.
max-sales: Re-running harness now; will report back.
jen-support: I'll follow up with a short note to CardioMetrics: what we changed (temporary bump + expiry), and the client-side optimization checklist. Also recommend a presales quota if they need sustained throughput after the POC.
max-sales: They reran — zero 429s during the demo run. Demo looks good. Thanks team! :tada:
